name: Olmo-3-7B-Instruct-OPSA
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 65536). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. On-policy self-adaptation (OPSA) RL run on allenai/Olmo-3-7B-Instruct: full 3-shard safetensors fine-tune, identical 7.298B tensor set, trained ONLY on the DAPO-17k question set (no other prompts), checkpoint step 319. Not a merge and not a quant - the config is byte-identical to the base and only the weights moved. Recorded because the card prints a base row and this row in ONE table with a stated sampling config (32 samples/prompt, temp 0.7, top-k 20, top-p 0.8, 32,768 max tokens): AIME24 54.48 -> 61.88 Avg@32, AIME25 38.75 -> 47.92, HMMT25 24.90 -> 29.69, MBPP+ 57.79 -> 59.61, GPQA_D 34.12 -> 35.64. Read the size of the win with care: the author's harness scores the base 34.12 on GPQA-D, while Ai2's own Olmo-3-7B-Instruct card prints 40.4, so this is a different (harsher) setup than Ai2's and the deltas - not the absolutes - are what the card actually demonstrates. The three math deltas are large and consistent across AIME24/AIME25/HMMT25, which is the real signal; MBPP+ and GPQA-D move by 1.5-1.8pp and are near noise.
